definitions.explanation: The executive body of government consisting of the prime minister and ministers.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{内閣|ないかく}が{発足|ほっそく}した。
{内閣|ないかく}が{総辞職|そうじしょく}した。
{内閣|ないかく}{支持率|しじりつ}が{下|さ}がった。

notes:
In Japan, the {内閣|ないかく} is the executive branch of government. It consists of the {内閣|ないかく}{総理|そうり}{大臣|だいじん} (Prime Minister) and {国務|こくむ}{大臣|だいじん} (Ministers of State), who head government ministries.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {内閣|ないかく}{総理|そうり}{大臣|だいじん}: Prime Minister (formal title)
- {内閣|ないかく}{改造|かいぞう}: cabinet reshuffle
- {内閣|ないかく}{支持率|しじりつ}: cabinet approval rating
- {内閣|ないかく}が{発足|ほっそく}する: a cabinet is formed/inaugurated
- {内閣|ないかく}{総辞職|そうじしょく}: mass resignation of the cabinet

USAGE:
Frequently appears in news about politics. The {内閣|ないかく} is often identified by the Prime Minister's name: {岸田|きしだ}{内閣|ないかく} (the Kishida Cabinet).

RELATED:
- {政府|せいふ}: government (broader term)
- {国会|こっかい}: National Diet (parliament)
